observations: Today's Most Popular list is identical to yesterday's: the same 100 games in the same order, so there are no risers, fallers, entries or exits. The Most Popular feed most likely did not refresh, and movement-based reads for this chart should wait for a fresh list.
The top is unchanged: 112-day-old Steal An Egg leads multi-year evergreens Brookhaven, RIVALS and Blox Fruits, with 57-day Throw Food For Animals and 28-day DONT SPLASH the young games near the top.
Games aged 85-122 days again have the weakest median percentile (23), below 15-42-day games (44) and games over a year old (68), still consistent with the mid-life trough (H-mp-009, 45%).

Recency of update jumped from 30% to 68% (H-mp-006), but that rests on a repeated list, so treat the jump with caution. The steadier signal is that days since the last update go with fewer days on the chart (rho=-0.38, best split at 32 days).
patterns: Pricing is still the most durable page signal: games whose median pass costs over 149 R$ consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-001, 80%), and higher-priced products and passes go with more days on the chart (rho=+0.27 each).
A high favorite rate per visit consistently marks lower positions (H-mp-010, 88%; rho=-0.41). Big evergreens turn few visits into favorites, so this reflects audience breadth rather than quality.

Social play tends to beat solo (H-mp-003, 65%, down from 70%). Among profiled games, wave-survival co-op (median percentile 92, n=3) and steal-and-defend (83, n=5) sit highest, and fixed obbies (29) and job sims (21) lowest.

Several long-running games profiled today lean on official brands (NFL Universe Football, Sonic Speed Simulator, a LEGO event in Brookhaven). That's a sign the oldest titles add outside IP to stay fresh, though it is speculative with so few cases.

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: Still leads at 112 days, in the age band where most games are in the trough; being the original of its wave keeps looking like an advantage its clones lack.

outliers.name: [STAGE 3] A Bizarre Run
outliers.note: Among the four weakest on Most Popular at 248 days, yet it rose 21 on Top Trending after a stage update, a revival that hasn't reached the dominance chart yet.

outliers.name: [WAR] Ragdoll Realism
outliers.note: Still near the bottom at 18 days after swinging ±46 earlier in the week, in line with ragdoll clones turning over within two weeks.

observations: Efficiency leaders are unchanged: social and RPG games with modest audiences (Summer Donations, Clover RPG, Bloodlines, Those Who Remain, Enter Brainrot), plus Trash Landfill Tycoon at 67 days with no passes and eight products.
The least efficient are again young big-audience games with little to buy: Bloody Ragdoll Physics, Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, Unstable SMP FFA and the folk-horror MALAM SAMA OPAH.

Jujutsu Farm rose another 86 places after +122 yesterday, and Dragon Tower Defense (+80), Build a Bridge (+70), Do Not Stop. (+68) and SF BIKE (+62) followed. Karinderya fell 55 more after -72, and Escape Traffic (-54), Lawn Care Empire (-48) and Military Tycoon (-45) slid.

Twelve games entered, a mix of updated veterans (Slayers 2, Rebirth Champions: Ultimate, Kingdom World) and 16-61-day games (Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, DigCrew, +1 Bow Forge, Okishima:1336, The Bizarre Journey). Twelve fell off, among them Steal A Verity and Drive World.
patterns: Price level is consistently the strongest lever: median product price (rho=+0.37, H-te-005 95%), premium passes above 999 R$ (H-te-006, 95%) and a median pass above 399 R$ (H-te-025, 95%).

RPGs (r=+0.55, H-te-011) and story-adventure loops (r=+0.40, H-te-046) consistently earn most per player, along with complex builds (H-te-013) and social play. Solo loops (r=-0.32), horror escapes (r=-0.39) and physics sandboxes (r=-0.55, H-te-045 94%) earn least.

Drivable vehicles consistently help (H-te-049, up to 88%): SF BIKE rose 62, and the excavator sim DigCrew and the Riyadh driving roleplay Kingdom World entered. Escape Traffic's -54 is the counter-case.

Idle and AFK income consistently earns less (H-te-038, up to 86%). Today's exceptions, Trash Landfill Tycoon and Build a Bridge, are tycoons with an active, physical job (hauling, bridge building) rather than pure waiting.
Title words echo the loop results: Ragdoll (r=-0.63), Egg (-0.57) and Steal (-0.46) mark the least efficient games, while Defense (+0.33), Life (+0.33) and World (+0.25) mark the more efficient.

outliers.name: [NEW] Jujutsu Farm
outliers.note: Up 208 places in two days at 32 days old, a roll-and-collect anime farm with 171 products; it fits the roll and luck layer signal (H-te-037, 67%).

outliers.name: [🍲] Karinderya!
outliers.note: Down 127 places in two days with 240 cheap products and no passes. A large, cheap catalog is not holding its place.

outliers.name: Build a Bridge
outliers.note: Rose 70 on Top Earning while falling 28 on Up-and-Coming at 25 days, a clean example of revenue catching up as the breakout fades (H-x-003).

observations: Stop The Tsunami! (+38, 33 days) now leads the momentum ranking, ahead of Shred The Cash (+19), Impossible Hill Climb, Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, +1 Glow Up Evolution and Barber Simulator.

The Ditch Hotel swung back up 23 after falling 33 yesterday at 14 days, and Cook Pizzas [Anomaly] rose 19. +1 Monkey Swing Escape (-66, 62 days), Onthel Purwodadi (-35), +1 Arm Length (-31) and WRECKED (-21) led the fallers.

Twelve games entered, including 12-day Sandworm Playground, 11-day Ragdoll Destruction Playground, the tethered two-player Gecko Duo, the airline co-op Cabin Chaos and the classroom game Be a Teacher!. Berry Avenue and three steal clones (Steal Eggs From Tsunami, Steal A Scooter, Steal A Balut) fell off.
58 of 77 scored games are 15-42 days old. The three games 14 days or younger have a median percentile of 90, and those over six weeks old 37, consistent with H-tt-001 (65%).
patterns: Survival is the strongest signal today: the Survival genre (r=+0.46, within-age +0.39) and survival framing (r=+0.39; momentum H-tt-048, 74%) go with higher positions, and a new genre test starts today.

Co-op play goes with faster climbing (r=+0.37, within-age +0.31) as well as higher positions (H-tt-023, 79%), so a momentum test starts today. Vehicles (H-tt-033, 73%) and creature themes (H-tt-074, 79%) consistently hold higher positions.

Original concepts consistently hold higher (H-tt-069, 80%; novelty rho=+0.29), while pet and egg games (H-tt-072, 75%) and +1 titles (r=-0.39) sit lower. Two +1 games are among the four weakest, and two more are among today's biggest fallers.
Luck products go with slower climbing (r=-0.36, within-age -0.30), adding to the luck-pass position signal (H-tt-039, 66%); a momentum test starts today.
Lower like ratios go with higher positions (rho=-0.28): divisive hook games such as Stop The Tsunami! (83%) and Tattoo to Get Rich (61%) climb, so a high rating is not what carries a young game here.

outliers.name: [🎨] Mix The Color!
outliers.note: Entered at 47 days with a 41% like ratio and no update for 40 days. A color-mixing elimination game climbing on curiosity alone fits the low-rating hook pattern.

outliers.name: +1 Monkey Swing Escape
outliers.note: Fell 66 at 62 days, past the six-week mark where momentum consistently fades, and the +1 template no longer protects it.

outliers.name: [STAGE 3] A Bizarre Run
outliers.note: Rose 21 at 248 days, outside the 0-4 month frame, so it isn't scored. A stage update brought a mid-life game back, like other aged revivals this week.

observations: Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (16 days) still leads, followed by Ragdoll Soccer, Stop The Tsunami!, Build a REAL House, Do Not Stop. and newcomer Sandworm Playground, which entered at #6 at 12 days.

The biggest risers were Clean The Bugs (+57), the Malay folk-horror Malam Sama Kembar (+38), Raise The Biggest Family (+34), +1 Spider Arm (+32) and the makeup game Facecard: Makeup Showdown (+28). Draw an aquarium (-34), Build a Bridge (-28), My iPad and Rarest Answer Party (-27 each) and Tornado Ragdoll Sandbox (-24) fell.

Eighteen games entered, including Anime Ragdoll Engine, Ant Evolution, Rollercoaster Tycoon, Steal A Balut, Punch the Butter, the classroom game Mukbang Students and 7-day Throw a Seed. Sixteen left, including BONK! Ragdoll Boxing, Build Sandbox and Bibi & Didi Obby.
The twelve games 14 days or younger have a median percentile of 74 against 51 for 15-42-day games (H-uc-005, 63%).
patterns: Co-op is the clearest social signal: co-op games consistently rank higher (H-uc-019, 85%; within-age +0.43), while the broader solo-versus-social contrast has weakened to 50% (H-uc-007).

Store design consistently matters: spins or crates (H-uc-068, 84%), storage or slot passes (H-uc-052, 83%) and revives (H-uc-021, 82%) go with higher positions, and currency packs lean lower (r=-0.22).
Originality (H-uc-039, 84%), complex builds (H-uc-067, 77%) and horror escapes (H-uc-057, 75%) consistently rank higher. The Survival genre has the largest within-age effect today (+0.57).
Reward-flex thumbnails rank lower (r=-0.33; H-uc-017, 74%). Steal mechanics (H-uc-066, 73%) and grow-a-garden loops (H-uc-027, 74%) consistently sit lower.
The physics-sandbox signal fell from 64% to 49% (H-uc-036), even though Ragdoll in the title still goes with higher positions (r=+0.29). The wave's leaders hold while its newer members come and go.

outliers.name: Sandworm Playground
outliers.note: Entered at #6 at 12 days and reached Top Trending the same day; play as a burrowing worm that swallows props and players, an original creature twist on destruction play (H-uc-055, 63%).

outliers.name: [UPD] Malam Sama Kembar
outliers.note: Rose 38 at 15 days, the latest in the Malay MALAM SAMA folk-horror series to climb. The regional-franchise idea was retired at 33% but keeps getting support.

outliers.name: Build a Bridge
outliers.note: Fell 28 here while rising 70 on Top Earning, a breakout handing over to revenue.

summary: The Most Popular list did not change from yesterday (same 100 games, same order), most likely a stale feed. Its movement-based reads, and H-mp-006's jump from 30% to 68%, should be checked against the next fresh list.

Breakout and earning still split: horror escapes go with higher Up-and-Coming positions (r=+0.34) but lower efficiency (r=-0.39), and physics sandboxes rank last on Top Earning (H-te-045, 94%). Price level, RPGs, story loops and vehicles drive Top Earning.

Co-op and survival now lead the breakout charts: co-op goes with Top Trending momentum (+0.37) and Up-and-Coming position (within-age +0.43), and the Survival genre with both (+0.46 and +0.57 within-age). New momentum and genre tests start today.

Classroom 1-vs-all games are spreading (Mukbang Students, Class Clowns, Be a Teacher!; H-x-041 up to 28%). Raise-a-family games where kids grow offline, and real-city driving roleplays, start today as new qualitative hypotheses.

Gameplay videos are still unlabelled for the fourteenth run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets. No new outside research was waiting. 60 games were profiled today.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (256 entries, up from 251, median 2 days), followed by tt→mp (198, unchanged because Most Popular didn't refresh).
uc→te (157, up from 155, 5 days) and tt→te (145, up from 142, 4 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue within about a week. te→tt stands at 98 (9 days) and tt→uc at 1.

Hyper Realistic Ragdoll entered Top Earning at 16 days and is now on all four charts, inside the week 3-5 window (H-x-004). Sandworm Playground entered Up-and-Coming and Top Trending on the same day at 12 days.
